study: Thursday 10:10 to 10:15 long, adapted from ES to Exness US500 CFD by user approval
entry: Buy every Thursday at the opening quote of the 10:10 M1 minute
exit: Sell at the opening bid quote of the 10:15 M1 minute; hold exactly five minutes
position_size: Fixed 1.00 US500 CFD lot; dollar conversion uses broker contract size. Not a stop-defined percentage-risk strategy.
gross_case: Bid-to-bid change, without spread, fees or slippage; non-executable diagnostic
baseline_cost_case: Ask at entry = recorded M1 bid open + recorded/previous positive M1 spread; bid at exit. Zero explicit Pro commission assumed; no overnight swaps.
zero_spread: Use preceding positive spread only, no future backfill. If no preceding positive spread is available, mark the cost-inclusive trade unavailable; gross may still be assessed.
cost_stress: Baseline +0.60 index points per round trip, comprising two ES ticks total (0.50 points) plus an illustrative 0.10-point commission equivalent. This is an assumption, not actual US500 commission or two MT5 point ticks.
severe_cost_stress: Baseline +1.10 index points per round trip: two ES ticks per side plus the same illustrative commission equivalent
data_quality: Require all six M1 timestamps from entry through exit, no price interpolation or stale fills. Missing days/years are unavailable, not zero-return periods. Trade holiday mornings if broker quotes exist, as the literal every-Thursday rule; do not impose an equity-market holiday filter on the futures-style rule.
neighborhood: Predeclared 25 long-only five-minute rules: Monday-Friday times 10:00, 10:05, 10:10, 10:15, 10:20 NY. Primary remains Thursday10:10 regardless of neighboring results.
clock_sensitivity: Thursday10:10 America/Chicago (=11:10 NY) shown separately because the transcript did not specify a zone
null_test: 5000 common-day random sign flips of gross five-minute changes across the 25-rule neighborhood, with spread costs always subtracted, never sign-flipped. Same day sign shared across all entry times preserves within-day correlation. Compare the fixed candidate and the family maximum; no claim to reproduce the unspecified original 8500-search universe.
sharpe: Daily fixed-cash P&L Sharpe sqrt(252), including no-trade weekdays within available source coverage. Also show per-trade cash Sharpe sqrt(52) because strategy trades weekly. Neither is asserted to match the video's unspecified Sharpe convention.
drawdown: Closed-balance peak-to-trough; intratrade adverse/favourable excursion available separately, not a full floating-equity path
lookahead_control: Entry and exit use minute OPEN quotes, not those minutes' eventual closes or the day's close. High/low used only for descriptive post-entry excursion; they never select entry or side.
not_included: Real tick bid/ask sequencing, latency, margin/rejections, historical specification changes, true ES futures contracts or roll rules
out_of_sample: 2024-2025 not requested and will not be peeked at. 2020-2023 is a retrospective reproduction, not claimed untouched OOS.
